title: I Changed 3 Words on My LinkedIn Bio — Response Rate Doubled Overnight
script: I changed three words on my LinkedIn bio. Response rate doubled overnight. The three words: results language and specificity. Bad bio: 'I'm passionate about marketing and love connecting with people.' Good bio: 'I help B2B SaaS companies double their inbound leads.' The first one is a personality description. The second one is a business outcome. Specific equals credible. Credible equals response. The algorithm and the recruiter both scan for one thing: what can this person actually do for me? Answer that in your first line. Everything else is noise.
